name: BoU National Payment Systems Act 2020 and Regulations 2021 (e-money issuers)
description: Template for payment service providers issuing e-money. Regulatory requirements from the National Payment Systems Act 2020 and the National Payment Systems Regulations 2021: e-money issued only against an equal amount in trust (s.47(1)(a)); 100% of e-money in unencumbered liquid assets, cash withdrawable on demand, treasury bills and bonds (s.60(1)-(2)); at most 20% of e-money in one institution unless total e-money is at most UGX 500m (reg 15(2)-(3)); a daily reconciliation statement (reg 22(5)) and a weekly breakdown of the trust (reg 22(6)). The trust figures are computed by the TRUST_RECON run, with the limits TRUST_COVERAGE_MIN, TRUST_BANK_CONCENTRATION_MAX and TRUST_SHORTFALL_MAX; the ratio here is the GL view of the same coverage. No deposit ratios. PLACEHOLDERS: the e-money liability GL, the buckets and the warnings.

ratios.name: Trust accounts to e-money liability (GL view)
ratios.description: The GL view of s.60 coverage: TRUST account balances over the e-money liability. The regulatory figure, with bills and bonds held in trust and encumbrance, is the TRUST_RECON run.
